answer: Emission per identity starts at a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 11 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 740 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. What carries the beacon here is verification, the falcon of cost is what stops the farm, and the shale of the record keeps every claim checkable.
